digest.component_or_area: Jira Cloud <-> Data Center adapter test parity
propositions: Cloud adapter (ACLI-based) has byte-for-byte characterization pins and large applier/differ corpus but lacks DC-specific coverage like pagination and rate-limit handling
Data Center adapter (pycontribs-based) has multi-page pagination proofs and 429 retry matrix but lacks value-level pinning for create-path fields and comment ceiling sourcing
Shared module map_fields_to_remote exists in duplicate across adapters and must be single-sourced with regression guards equivalent to status/priority maps
Vacuous or underspecified contract tests exist that either fail to assert their docstring intent or merely pin shape without values, requiring rewrite or assertion clarification
Cloud and DC adapters have legitimate divergences (ADF vs wiki markup, accountId vs name identity) that must be tested with different expected values per vendor rather than sameness assertions

Production confidence in DC adapter deployment depends on value-level characterization pins and verified contract tests covering operational edges (index lag, page caps, rate limiting, screen config) that incident-hardened Cloud tests never encountered
